title: Embrace Boredom
coreMove: Train the mind to stay with a chosen problem by deciding when distraction is allowed before the urge arrives.
sourcePressure: The source frame says concentration must be trained and distraction should be scheduled instead of waiting for focus to appear.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version says take breaks from your phone; the real move is rehearsing resistance to distraction while the urge is active.

tryThisNow: wait five minutes before checking your phone
put your phone across the room

exampleSpecs.domain: a chess arbiter studying endgame rulings between tournament rounds
exampleSpecs.audience: a rules expert whose mind wants relief from dense positions
exampleSpecs.stakes: a contested ruling later that afternoon depends on precise recall
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: when the urge to check scores hits, she points to the scheduled break time and returns to the same rook-pawn diagram
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a printed rook-pawn endgame diagram under a tournament pairing sheet

exampleSpecs.domain: a field ecologist waiting through a silent bird count
exampleSpecs.audience: a scientist whose data quality depends on not filling quiet gaps
exampleSpecs.stakes: one premature movement ruins the survey window
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes the next allowed radio-check time on her wrist card and stays still through the restless minute
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a damp wrist card clipped to a binocular strap before sunrise

exampleSpecs.domain: a trial consultant reading jury questionnaires for contradiction patterns
exampleSpecs.audience: a consultant who keeps escaping difficult ambiguity
exampleSpecs.stakes: a strike recommendation becomes shallow if she scans instead of analyzes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she notices the browser impulse, writes the exact time for the next allowed check, and returns to the same contradictory answer pair
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two questionnaire answers highlighted in different colors on a tablet

exampleSpecs.domain: a jazz pianist practicing a difficult left-hand pattern
exampleSpecs.audience: a musician whose practice breaks when discomfort appears
exampleSpecs.stakes: the ensemble rehearsal exposes the weak passage if he keeps skipping it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he schedules phone checks between repetitions and repeats the same four bars until the hand stops searching for escape
exampleSpecs.firstImage: four measures circled on a chart beside a silent metronome light

exampleSpecs.domain: a cybersecurity analyst reverse-engineering a malware sample
exampleSpecs.audience: a technical analyst facing long stretches of uncertainty
exampleSpecs.stakes: a false classification leaves a client exposed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after a shallow first pass, he schedules message checks and stays with one suspicious function until the behavior is clear
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a disassembler window paused at a function with a strange loop

exampleSpecs.domain: a textile conservator removing adhesive from a fragile banner
exampleSpecs.audience: a conservator whose patience is part of the skill
exampleSpecs.stakes: one rushed pull tears a historic fabric edge
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she waits through the urge to switch tasks, keeps the tool at the same angle, and logs the next break rather than taking one early
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a linen banner edge held flat under a cool inspection lamp

skillTargets: choose responses to urges during hard focus
evaluate whether a break pattern trains or weakens attention

tryThisNowSpec: Choose the next moment you are allowed to check a distraction, write the time down, and return to the same hard sentence or problem until that time arrives.
